list.name: Changes
list.comment:
BROKEN - Buffered Parallel Processing Overhaul
v0.6.0X
Jun 17 2026 A
CHANGES - Numerous changes across buffered parallel processing - Buffer parallel processing is currently non-functional - Created the Processor class to represent a generator or a post processor - The class streamlines applying a function to inputs - Buffered parallel processing now uses string indexing instead of numerical indexing - Buffered parallel processing can no w have multiple generators, outputs, and/or instances of a certain generator or post processor - Improved ease of use for debug information in buffered parallel processing
TODO - Fix the current issues with buffered parallel processing - Introduce a PID system to control how resources are allocated for buffered parallel processing - Write a README.md and improve documentation
